acceptable_evidence: Primary pages with exact effective/access dates
decision_prevented: Independent verification of any external claim, including fee schedules that already killed candidates; the arithmetic is unaffected, the auditability is.
disallowed_evidence: A URL for a different page, version or product family than the token refers to
kill_condition: A re-derived fact contradicts the report-mediated value (that is a finding, not a failure)
priority_reason: M1-BLOCKING retained: decisions already rest on these facts, and re-derivation is the cheapest available integrity upgrade.
required_answer: A resolvable URL plus snapshot for each of the 25 report-mediated external sources
success_condition: Every decision-relevant external fact is re-derived from a primary page
title: Citation-token to primary-URL resolution
